mentions.name: Expense Bot (Telegram expense tracker)
mentions.description: A Telegram bot for tracking expenses, built for the author and their family, who are heavy Telegram users. The code is being written largely by AI agents (Claude and AMP, as seen in the git history), serving as a hands-on experiment to learn about AI agents' strengths, limitations, and the guardrails, guidelines, and checks needed to use them properly.
mentions.problem: The author wanted an expense tracker that fits their family's heavy Telegram usage, and a practical vehicle for learning what AI agents are good at and where they fall short.
mentions.audience: Heavy Telegram users, specifically the author and their family members
mentions.source_excerpt: I am getting the AI Agents to build an expense tracker Telegram. I would like to have one myself and among my family members since we are heavy Telegram users.

evidence.value: I am getting the AI Agents to build an expense tracker Telegram. I would like to have one myself and among my family members since we are heavy Telegram users.
